PLAN "12-Week Strength and Hypertrophy, starting 2026-06-01"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength"
  GOAL secondary body_composition:
    name "Improve body composition through progressive hypertrophy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Hypertrophy Base" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds

          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
